resources.string: Not granted — needed to read shared files
Could not read rclone configuration. The native library may have failed to load on this device.
Transfer history is not recorded yet, so no totals are shown.
A backup of your previous config was kept.
That file could not be imported as an rclone config.
Importing merges the selected file into the config already on this phone. Remotes with the same name will be overwritten, and a backup is kept first.
Adding a remote needs a per-backend settings form driven by rclone’s config/providers output. That screen is not built yet. Configured remotes can still be browsed and deleted here.
Shared storage is not available on this device
This removes the remote’s stored credentials from rclone.conf. It cannot be undone from the app.
